_comment: Released checkpoints and data files (paths relative to the workspace root, hairdeck.paths). "checkpoint" is the released file (safetensors, hairdeck.ckpt), "trained" the training output of "command" it is made from. _public_strings: names that may appear in the export although they contain a private string (the VRM author of the avatar body).

dora_condition.command: scripts/data.py DATASET_DIR VRM_DIR --steps dora  (both splits from the dataset's hair_reform.ply; scripts/test.py pointcloud computes the test condition itself from CHARM's released test point clouds data/charm_test_pc)

point_cloud_dit.sampling: scripts/test.py pointcloud  (the test set: 50 Euler steps, CFG 2, seeds 0, 1, 2 in results/pointcloud/seed<k>, then the evaluation)

chain_dit.sampling: scripts/test.py chains  (the test set on the artists' cards: 50 Euler steps, CFG 2, seeds 0, 1, 2 in results/chains/seed<k>, then the evaluation; --cards results/pointcloud: on the point-cloud model's cards, chain seed k on card seed k)

image_dit.about: the image model: RGB input (DINOv3 ViT-L/16 tokens of the 448 px crop), head frame, widened synthetic augmentation, restyled renders mixed in with p 0.33, initialised from the point-cloud model, 100K steps
image_dit.sampling: scripts/image_to_hair.py IMAGE --out OUT  (hairdeck.infer.image.Pipeline: Euler 50, CFG 2, seed 0)

inference_data.about: card token normalisation (point-cloud and head-frame models), the canonical head of the head frame (W, O; head proxy), chain token statistics of the chain DiT

avatar_body.about: the avatar body of the VRM export (hairdeck.vrm; a VRoid Studio template avatar): the VRM, its original hair (hair.glb, for the check that the export removed it) and body.json with its head-frame fit and the VRM meta written into exported files (author hyz317, Apache-2.0)

demo_examples.about: the 12 example images of the demo (examples.json lists them in the order shown)

test_data.about: evaluation data of scripts/test.py (file names: test row, 000 to 099): the cards of the original hair meshes of the 100 test cases (CHARM-format card json, 8 columns; for the 24 combined-template cases, of their two template meshes) and the true width direction at each of their control points (test_cards_orig_dirs.npz), read by the pointcloud test; the spring-bone chains of the test characters (as extracted from their VRM files, and as chain tokens in the head frame) and the card features and head-frame card latents of the GT cards that the chain model is conditioned on, and the test characters' head fits and head frames, read by the chains test
